name: Premium Minimal
tagline: Floating glass, white space, one confident accent.
description: Apple-grade product film: white canvas, near-black type, the brand colour as a single accent, glass and real depth, springs you feel but never see bounce, and UI choreography that becomes the next scene.

signature: container transform: an inline chip or card grows into the next scene
camera push into a UI element that becomes full-screen
type assembles word by word, letters settling out of depth blur

camera: Shallow 2.5D: slow push-ins on floating UI, a slight tilt of the canvas for depth, settles with a long ease; never handheld.

texture.notes: Clean. Glass blur, soft wide shadows, a brand-coloured light bloom rising from the frame edge on key beats.

lighting: Soft studio key, contact shadows, coloured light passing through glass on accent moments.
sound: Tactile clicks and soft settles, restrained air sweeps that peak at seams, a clean confirmation chime; music with space.

beats.label: Canvas tilts, satellites in, Share pressed

motionSummary: Moves like a product interface: a caret types, a word becomes a window, the canvas tilts into depth, then everything folds back home.

composition: one focal point, centred or on a strong third
lots of negative space; empty is intentional
UI floats on a quiet white set; depth by layering, never clutter
visual.shapeLanguage: rounded rectangles and pills (container radius 24–46 px), hairline borders, soft wide shadows
visual.contrast: low-contrast white set, near-black type, the accent as the only saturated colour; light bloom on key beats

grammar.pacing: calm scene tempo with snappy UI response: one idea per beat, holds of 0.5–1.2 s on key numbers
grammar.rhythm: smooth, on ones; springs on anything touched; continuous camera across scenes
grammar.easing: enter ease-out, exit ease-in, state change ease-in-out; springs with 2–5 % overshoot on buttons, cards, toasts
grammar.acceleration: fast response (80–250 ms) then a long settle; camera moves accelerate gently and settle for 0.5–1 s
movement: cursor on curved paths, press compression
grammar.density: low: 1–3 elements moving at once; the rest holds still
grammar.holds: every beat lands and holds long enough to read twice

transitionPresets.name: Container transform
transitionPresets.bridge: an inline chip, pill or card
transitionPresets.build: the container interpolates position, size and radius into the next scene's frame; old content fades out in the first third, new content in during the last third
transitionPresets.sound: soft air sweep peaking mid-move, tactile settle

transitionPresets.name: Push through the UI
transitionPresets.bridge: a UI element the camera pushes into
transitionPresets.build: camera pushes in (log zoom) until the element fills the frame and becomes the next scene; the bezel or card edge leaves frame
transitionPresets.sound: low air rise, click on arrival

transitionPresets.name: Type assembly
transitionPresets.build: letters arrive scattered in depth with blur and settle into the word while the previous line drifts back and blurs out

transitionPresets.name: Fold home
transitionPresets.bridge: the card that opened the scene
transitionPresets.build: satellites and toasts leave first (exit ease), the card folds back into its pill, the pill into the caret
transitionPresets.sound: reverse air sweep, a final soft click

transitionPresets.name: Tilt reveal
transitionPresets.build: the whole canvas tilts 8–14° into depth, revealing satellites at other Z depths by parallax

archetypes.name: Kinetic caption
archetypes.purpose: say the promise in a few words
archetypes.composition: one line centred on white, the key word in an accent pill
archetypes.elements: words enter one by one from depth blur; a caret leads them
archetypes.motion: type on ones, pill springs in last

archetypes.name: Floating hero UI
archetypes.purpose: show the product doing the thing
archetypes.composition: one glass card or device on white, real UI, generous margins
archetypes.elements: numbers count up, a chart line draws, rows lift
archetypes.motion: slow push-in, content animates inside the card
archetypes.camera: slow push-in with a long settle

archetypes.name: Depth stack
archetypes.purpose: show breadth: everything around the core feature
archetypes.composition: tilted canvas, the hero card in front, 2–3 satellites at other depths
archetypes.elements: satellites float in with parallax, values in each

archetypes.name: Interaction beat
archetypes.composition: close on a control: a button, toggle or row
archetypes.elements: cursor moves on a curve, pauses, presses; the button compresses; a toast springs up
archetypes.motion: curved cursor path, press 1.00 → 0.96 → 1.01 → 1.00, toast spring
archetypes.camera: locked or a tiny push to the press

archetypes.name: End lockup
archetypes.composition: logo mark and wordmark centred, one line below, accent bloom from the bottom edge
archetypes.elements: mark resolves from the last pill; line types in

beats.purpose: one quiet line sets up the promise
beats.motion: caret, word-by-word type, the key word lands in a pill
the pill becomes the hero card; numbers count, the chart draws
canvas tilts, satellites float in, a cursor presses, a toast springs up
accent bloom rises behind the key result; the biggest number holds
everything folds home into the mark; one line; hold

sequence.cutRhythm: no hard cuts: one continuous camera and container chain; scene changes land on phrase starts

scenes.action: 'Everything your team ships, in one view.' types in; 'view.' lands in a green pill
the pill grows into the dashboard card; 12,480 counts up, the chart line draws
canvas tilts; Design 98 % and Reviews 1.2k float in at depth
push to the Share button; cursor presses; 'Shared with the team' springs up; green bloom
everything folds into the pill, the pill becomes the logo mark; one line; hold 1.5 s

elements.text: sentence case, word by word from depth blur; key word in an accent pill; leaves by drifting back and blurring
elements.logo: resolves from the last container (pill → mark); springs with the logo spring; never spins
elements.icons: line icons in UI weight; scale-in with a small spring; no bounce loops
elements.images: real product UI only, sharp and large; device renders with real proportions
elements.ui: glass or white cards with hairline borders; contents animate inside (counters, charts, rows); every press compresses
elements.shapes: pills and rounded rects that become windows (mattes); no decorative shapes
elements.background: quiet white set; the accent arrives as light (a bloom from the frame edge), never a fill

audio.sync: scene changes on phrase starts and downbeats; UI hits (press, toast) on light percussion; leave space for VO
audio.sfx: clicks, soft settles, air sweeps peaking at seams, one confirmation chime
